title: Random Effects Every 10 Seconds
description: Gives the players 1 random effect every 10 seconds
body:
Arranca el datapack con **/function er:start** y cada 10 segundos todos los jugadores recibirán un efecto aleatorio. Eso es todo...

-----------------------------------------

Start the datapack with **/function er:start** and it will give all the players a random effect every 10 seconds. Thats all...

(The datapack is in spanish but there is very little text, so it should be no problem even if you dont understand it)
